purpose: Expose the FT-001 session API surface with stable safe errors and browser/PWA default session transport.
success_outcome: Clients can login, logout, and inspect the current safe session summary through FastAPI routes without leaking auth material.

forbidden_scope: raw auth material in responses or evidence

commands: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check FT-001 session route registration preserves Foundation Smoke API /health and /ready behavior.
Check login Set-Cookie uses agro_intellect_session with HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800, Expires aligned with session_expires_at, and correct Secure behavior for loopback versus HTTPS.
Check logout clears agro_intellect_session with matching name/path/samesite/secure mode, Max-Age=0, expired Expires, and idempotent 204 behavior for missing or invalid sessions.
Check bearer mode, if implemented, returns a raw token only once through the allowed non-browser/LAN boundary, emits no cookie, sets no-store cache behavior, and persists only token_hash.
Check session API errors match the FT-001 Error Contract and API Guidelines without leaking auth material.
success_checks: POST /api/session/login returns safe session summary and sets the browser/PWA cookie named agro_intellect_session with HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800, Expires aligned to session_expires_at, and Secure behavior matching FT-001 loopback/HTTPS rules.
Invalid login returns generic AUTH_CREDENTIAL_INVALID without account enumeration.

POST /api/session/logout revokes/clears current session and is idempotent for missing or invalid sessions, clearing agro_intellect_session with matching name/path/samesite/secure mode, Max-Age=0, and an expired Expires value.
GET /api/session/me returns safe actor/session summary without auth material.
Explicit bearer mode, when implemented, emits no session cookie, returns the raw token only once through the allowed non-browser/LAN response boundary, and still persists only token_hash.
Validation and auth errors use stable codes and redacted safe messages.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present.
evidence_required: Set-Cookie evidence for agro_intellect_session name, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age=604800, Expires/session_expires_at alignment, and loopback versus HTTPS Secure behavior
logout clear-cookie evidence for agro_intellect_session with Max-Age=0, expired Expires, and idempotent missing/invalid session behavior
bearer-mode boundary evidence when bearer mode is implemented, including no-cookie emission and token_hash-only persistence

stop_conditions: Route behavior conflicts with FT-001 error contract.
Cookie attributes, clear-cookie behavior, or bearer-mode boundaries cannot be verified without leaking token material.
Browser/PWA session response includes the raw token outside the cookie transport.
Implementation requires FT-003 public route ownership.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
